steps.title: Fire, built in
steps.body: The library on the left has your effects under Mine and the editor's own under Built-in. Clicking one plays it in the middle, over and over, on a floor of studs. Fire is a stream: it keeps making small plates that rise, shrink and go from yellow to dark red.
steps.task: In the library, under Built-in, click “Fire”.

how.text: In the library on the left, scroll to Built-in and click “Fire”. It starts playing in the preview.

steps.title: Your own copy
steps.body: A built-in effect cannot be changed, so every game can count on it. To change one, make a copy: the copy belongs to this game, shows under Mine, and has every setting on the right.
steps.task: On the right, click “Make a copy to change it”.

how.text: In Effect settings on the right, click “Make a copy to change it”. “Fire copy” appears under Mine and is selected.

do.say: Make a copy to change it

steps.title: Name it
steps.body: Give your effect a name that says what it is: logic, actions and the Scene show effects by name.

how.text: Click the Name box at the top of the settings, replace “Fire copy” with “Blue fire” and press Enter.

steps.title: Made of studs
steps.body: Each particle is a tiny brick, plate, tile or stud. Plates look like flames; round studs look like magic.

how.text: Under “Made of”, click “Studs”. The preview now throws little round studs.

steps.title: Blue flames
steps.body: The colours go from birth to death: a particle starts with Colour 1 and fades through the next ones to the last. Fire goes yellow, orange, red, dark red; change the middle two to make it blue.
steps.task: Make Colour 2 blue (#3a7bff) and Colour 3 dark blue (#1f3fbf).

how.text: Under Colours, click the second swatch (Colour 2) and pick blue, #3a7bff.
Click the third swatch (Colour 3) and pick dark blue, #1f3fbf. The flames turn blue.

steps.title: On the map
steps.body: An effect placed on a map plays there in the game: a torch, a campfire, a magic well. Place on the map puts it beside where the player starts and opens the Scene with it selected; its properties are on the right.
steps.task: At the top of the preview, click “Place on the map”.

how.text: Above the preview, click “Place on the map”. The Scene opens with the effect selected next to the start.

steps.title: A blue level up
steps.body: Game effects pick which effect plays when things happen in this game. Built-in uses the editor's own; your own effects are in each list too.
steps.task: Back in Effects, under Game effects, set “Level up” to “Blue fire”.

how.text: Click the Effects tab at the top to go back.
On the right, scroll down to Game effects. In the “Level up” list, pick “Blue fire”. When the hero levels up in Play, blue flames burst around them.
